templates.title: Critical Procurement: Water Filters
templates.description: The shelter filtration system is reaching critical saturation. Procure replacement filtration units from the abandoned hospital.

templates.title: Supply Escort: Merchant Courier
templates.description: Escort a Supply Corps trade liaison safely through the highway pileup to secure regional barter lines.

templates.title: Reconnaissance: Flooded Depot Transmissions
templates.description: An erratic beacon pulses from the flooded subway depot. Survey the installation and assess water table intrusion.

templates.title: Perimeter Guard: Terrace Pumphouse
templates.description: Scavenger bands threaten the outer terrace pumphouse. Fortify the station and repel encroachment.

templates.description: Deliver transit protocol ratification documents to the Railway Guild checkpoint at Junction Box Rail.

templates.title: Expedition: Municipal Seed Vault
templates.description: Conduct an exploratory survey into the municipal seed vault sub-basement to catalog surviving agricultural cultivars.

templates.title: Mediation: Neutral Ground Truce
templates.description: Arbitrate a tense salvage boundary dispute between rival survivor scouting teams on neutral ground.
